verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents an Ollama integration guide for self-hosting (lobe-chat-docs-36) and supports self-hosting on your own infrastructure (lobe-chat-docs-62). The desktop app is marketed as running locally and privacy-first (lobe-chat-docs-20), and chat data is stored client-side by default (lobe-chat-docs-44). That covers the core of local-model use via Ollama, but the rest of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented support for llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM; explicit confirmation that it runs fully offline with no cloud model dependency; hands-on or independent corroboration of a local-only setup.
